$comment: Slim feature manifest for web/ (ReDesign2): one entry per BUILD-SPEC feature. `name` is the spec's label, or its slice when the spec names none. `journeys` is generated (npm run check:features -- --write). A feature with no journey carries a `gap`. CI runs the check; the old app's feature-manifest.json goes at cut-over.
